title: Extraction Method E (PRP)
author: Faezah Mohd Salleh
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.inecdbe
materials: Discard supernatant without disturbing the pellet.
Prior to library construction, analyze small aliquots of each extract on Nanodrop (Thermo Fischer Scientific, Darmstadt, DE) for estimation of DNA concentration.

steps.title: Tissue mincing
steps.instruction: Cut the tissue into small pieces.

steps.title: Add lysis reagents
steps.instruction: Add 500 µl Lyse 1, 50 µl Lyse 2, and 10 µl Proteinase K (concentrations undetermined).

steps.title: Incubate lysate
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture in a shaker at 65 °C for 12 hours.

steps.title: Transfer supernatant
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant to a new tube.

steps.title: Precipitate with isopropanol
steps.instruction: Add 640 µl isopropanol and mix by inversion.

steps.title: Remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Remove the supernatant without touching the pellet.

steps.title: Dry pellet
steps.instruction: Dry the pellet at 37 °C with the lid open for up to 5 minutes.

steps.title: Resuspend pellet
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 100 µl ddH₂O (concentration undetermined).
